title: Partite matching code condition
statement: For natural numbers $q,k$ and a perfect matching code of index $(qk)/2$, decode the code on the list of vertices $0,1,\ldots,qk-1$. The code is partite when every decoded edge has endpoints whose integer quotients upon division by $k$ are unequal.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching code of index $(qk)/2$
caveat: The decoding convention for perfect matching codes is referenced but not included in the supplied definitions.
